title: Centre clears appointment of 3 judicial officers as additional judges of Andhra Pradesh High Court
description: The Central government on Friday cleared the appointment of three judicial officers as additional judges of the Andhra Pradesh High Court.The three judicial officers are:Sunitha Gandham; Alapati Giridhar; Purushottam Kumar Chintelapudi.Arjun Ram Meghwal, Minister of Law and Justice (Independent Charge) took to X (formerly Twitter) to announce the appointments.In exercise of the powers conferred by the Constitution of India, in consultation with Chief Justice of India, the President is pleased to
